verdict.rationale: The only CLI in the evidence is `honeymarker`, a lightweight first-party command-line tool for CRUD management of markers. That covers one narrow slice of the product rather than a general official CLI for querying, managing resources, or running agent workflows. The API, MCP server, and agent-skills plugin are separate interfaces, not a CLI. Missing for 10: a general-purpose official CLI covering queries, datasets, triggers and SLOs; documentation of AI-native or agent-friendly CLI workflows; independent or hands-on corroboration.
